messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Moving to Java 8
parts:
Dear all,

As we aim to support the widest-possible set of use cases for Renjin, we've stuck with Java 7 support for quite a long time.

But of course the world is moving forward, and there are a lot of very nice things in Java 8 for Renjin, such as new primitives for unsigned math (handy for compiling C code) and new API support for trapping integer overflow, just to name two.

Later this week, we'll release the first build of Renjin 0.9, which will be built with and require Java 8. 

If you're still using Renjin in a Java 7 environment, you can of course continue to use previous builds of Renjin 0.8.x and all the packages built to date for Renjin 0.8.x, but we won't build new R packages against Java 7.

If this is going to create problems for existing deployments with Renjin, please let me know, and we'll see if we can find a solution for you.

All the best,
Alex
